description: Create a subaccount on a Storage Box, scoped to a home directory with its own password and access settings.

access_settings.description: Initial access settings for the subaccount

reachable_externally.description: Whether the subaccount is reachable from outside the Hetzner network

readonly.description: Whether the subaccount has read-only access

samba_enabled.description: Whether Samba/CIFS access is enabled for the subaccount

ssh_enabled.description: Whether SSH/SFTP/SCP access is enabled for the subaccount

webdav_enabled.description: Whether WebDAV access is enabled for the subaccount

home_directory.description: Home directory the subaccount is scoped to, e.g. "/backups/web"

name.description: Optional display name for the subaccount

name: hetzner_create_storage_box_subaccount
title: Create Storage Box Subaccount
